ei.title: 3번: The Hacking Risk of Self-Driving Cars
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken seriously.

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many (A)[drawbacks / benefits], experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, (B)[ignore / adjust] the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a (C)[clear / vague] message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) benefits=이점 / drawbacks=결점 (B) adjust=조절하다 / ignore=무시하다 (C) clear=분명한 / vague=모호한
det.analysis:
① benefits—adjust—clear: 자동차의 이점(benefits), 에어컨을 조절(adjust), 분명한(clear) 메시지 — 모두 문맥에 맞음 ←정답
② drawbacks: 결점은 '많은 이점'과 반대
③ ignore: 에어컨을 '무시하다'는 조절 문맥과 반대
④ drawbacks/ignore/vague: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 자율주행차의 이점(benefits)과 시연이 주는 분명한(clear) 메시지 흐름

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, (A)[amateurs / experts] warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to (B)[change / maintain] the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a (C)[real / fake] issue that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) experts=전문가 / amateurs=아마추어 (B) change=바꾸다 / maintain=유지하다 (C) real=진짜의 / fake=가짜의
det.analysis:
① experts—maintain—fake: (B) maintain(유지)·(C) fake(가짜)는 문맥과 반대
② experts—change—real: 전문가(experts)가 경고, 라디오 볼륨을 바꿈(change), 진짜(real) 문제 ←정답
③ amateurs—change—fake: (A) amateurs·(C) fake 반대
④ amateurs—maintain—real: (A)(B) 반대
det.tip: 경고하는 전문가(experts)와 볼륨을 바꾸는(change) 해킹, 진짜(real) 위협 흐름

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential (A)[protections / targets] for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and (B)[stop / accelerate] the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken (C)[seriously / lightly].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) targets=표적 / protections=보호 (B) stop=멈추다 / accelerate=가속하다 (C) seriously=진지하게 / lightly=가볍게
det.analysis:
① protections—stop—seriously: (A) protections(보호)는 '해커의 표적'과 반대
② targets—accelerate—lightly: (B) accelerate(가속)·(C) lightly(가볍게) 반대
③ targets—stop—seriously: 표적(targets), 차를 멈춤(stop), 진지하게(seriously) 받아들임 ←정답
④ protections—accelerate—lightly: 모두 반대
det.tip: 해커의 표적(targets), 차를 멈춤(stop), 진지하게(seriously) 다뤄야 함

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet ①<u>access</u> on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more ②<u>potential</u> targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are ③<u>secure</u>. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the ④<u>transmission</u> and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① access=접근 ② potential=잠재적인 ③ vulnerable→secure (부적절) ④ transmission=변속기
det.analysis:
① access: 인터넷 접속이 되는 자율주행차 — 적절
② potential: 해커의 잠재적 표적 — 적절
③ secure: 스마트카가 '안전하다'? 곧 해킹당하므로 vulnerable(취약한)이 원문 ←정답
④ transmission: 변속기를 장악 — 적절
det.tip: 시연에서 해킹당함 → 차는 secure가 아니라 vulnerable(취약한)

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts ①<u>warn</u> that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a ②<u>demonstration</u> that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to ③<u>change</u> the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a ④<u>fake</u> issue that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① warn=경고하다 ② demonstration=시연 ③ change=바꾸다 ④ real→fake (부적절)
det.analysis:
① warn: 전문가들이 경고하다 — 적절
② demonstration: 시연을 통해 입증 — 적절
③ change: 라디오 볼륨을 바꾸다 — 적절
④ fake: '가짜' 문제인데 진지하게 받아들이라? real(진짜)이 원문 ←정답
det.tip: must be taken seriously와 모순 → fake가 아니라 real(진짜)

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet ①<u>access</u> on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential ②<u>allies</u> for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a ③<u>demonstration</u> that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① access=접근 ② targets→allies (부적절) ③ demonstration=시연 ④ transmission=변속기
det.analysis:
① access: 인터넷 접속 — 적절
② allies: 해커의 '협력자'? 자동차는 해커의 targets(표적)이 됨 ←정답
③ demonstration: 시연을 통해 입증 — 적절
④ transmission: 변속기를 장악 — 적절
det.tip: 해커에게 자동차는 협력자(allies)가 아니라 표적(targets)

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hackers=해커 / experts=전문가 / researchers=연구원 / drivers=운전자
det.analysis:
① experts: 전문가는 경고하는 주체 — 표적이 아님
② researchers: 연구원은 시연한 주체 — 부적절
③ drivers: 운전자는 피해자 — 부적절
④ hackers: 자율주행차가 많아지면 해커의 표적이 늘어남 ←정답
det.tip: more potential targets for ___ → 사이버 보안 맥락의 위협 주체 = hackers

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: vulnerable=취약한 / secure=안전한 / expensive=비싼 / popular=인기있는
det.analysis:
① vulnerable: 컴퓨터로 차를 장악당했으므로 취약함 ←정답
② secure: 안전하다? 뒤에서 해킹당하므로 반대
③ expensive: 비싸다? 해킹 가능성과 무관
④ popular: 인기있다? 문맥과 무관
det.tip: even today's smart cars are ___ + 곧 해킹당함 → vulnerable(취약한)

det.korean: transmission=변속기 / radio=라디오 / air conditioner=에어컨 / windshield wipers=와이퍼

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 warn과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: warn=경고하다 / caution=주의를 주다 / praise=칭찬하다 / promise=약속하다 / reward=보상하다

③ promise: 약속하다 — 의미 다름
④ reward: 보상하다 — 의미 다름
det.tip: experts warn(경고하다) = caution

det.korean: adjust=조절하다 / remove=제거하다 / install=설치하다 / regulate=조절하다 / break=부수다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 proved와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: proved=입증했다 / denied=부인했다 / confirmed=확인했다 / doubted=의심했다 / guessed=추측했다
det.analysis:

④ guessed: 추측했다 — 의미 다름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 vulnerable과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: vulnerable=취약한 / secure=안전한 / weak=약한 / exposed=노출된 / sensitive=민감한

② weak: 약한 — vulnerable의 유의어
③ exposed: 노출된 — vulnerable의 유의어
④ sensitive: 민감한 — 의미 축이 다름
det.tip: vulnerable(취약한)의 반대 = secure(안전한). weak·exposed는 유의어

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 real과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: real=진짜의, 실제의 / genuine=진짜의 / actual=실제의 / serious=심각한 / imaginary=상상의
det.analysis:
① genuine: 진짜의 — real의 유의어
② actual: 실제의 — real의 유의어
③ serious: 심각한 — 의미 축이 다름
④ imaginary: 상상의, 가상의 — real(진짜의)의 반의어 ←정답
det.tip: real(진짜의)의 반대 = imaginary(가상의). genuine·actual은 유의어

questions.passage:
(A) The government plans to <u>issue</u> new driver's licenses to citizens next year. The whole process will be handled online for convenience.

(B) Automotive cybersecurity is a real <u>issue</u> that must be taken seriously by carmakers. If it is ignored, many drivers could be put in danger.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 issue의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: issue: (A) 발급하다, 발행하다 (B) 문제, 사안
det.analysis:
① (A) 문제 (B) 발급하다: (A)에서 면허를 '문제'? 부적절
② (A) 발급하다 (B) 문제, 사안: 면허를 발급(issue)하다 + 진짜 문제(a real issue) ←정답
③ (A) 발급하다 (B) 결과: (B) 사이버 보안이 '결과'? 부적절
④ (A) (잡지) 호 (B) 문제: (A) 면허 한 '호'? 부적절
det.tip: issue의 다의어: 발급하다(동사) vs 문제·사안(명사)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "possible but not yet actual; capable of developing into something real in the future"

det.korean: potential=잠재적인 / essential=필수적인 / financial=재정의 / personal=개인의
det.analysis:
① potential: 아직 실제는 아니지만 미래에 실현될 수 있는 — 정의와 일치 ←정답
② essential: 필수적인 — 정의와 무관
③ financial: 재정의 — 정의와 무관
④ personal: 개인의 — 정의와 무관
det.tip: possible but not yet actual(가능하지만 아직 실제 아님) = potential(잠재적인)

questions.passage: Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently __________ (prove) through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: prove(입증하다) → proved(과거형). 'recently'와 함께 과거 시제
det.analysis: prove를 과거형 proved로 변환. 'Researchers recently ___ (prove)' = 연구원들이 최근에 입증했다 — recently(최근에)는 과거 시제와 호응
det.tip: recently + 과거 시제 → proved

questions.passage: Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government. Automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be __________ (take) seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: take(받아들이다) → taken(과거분사). 'must be taken' 수동태 구문
det.analysis: take를 과거분사 taken으로 변환. 'a real issue that must be ___ (take) seriously' = 진지하게 받아들여져야 하는 문제 — 조동사+be+p.p. 수동태에서 과거분사 필요
det.tip: must be _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → taken

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more __________ for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: potential targets=잠재적 표적 / safety features=안전 기능 / fuel options=연료 옵션 / traffic rules=교통 법규
det.analysis:
① safety features: 안전 기능이 '해커에게' 늘어남? 부적절
② fuel options: 연료 옵션과 해커는 무관
③ potential targets: 자율주행차가 많아지면 해커의 잠재적 표적이 늘어남 ←정답
④ traffic rules: 교통 법규와 해커는 무관
det.tip: means having more ___ for hackers → potential targets(잠재적 표적)

questions.passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers. Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today's "smart" cars are vulnerable. They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it. They were not only able to change the radio's volume, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the windshield wipers on, but they were also able to take control of the transmission and stop the car as it was driving down the highway. Fortunately, it was just a demonstration, but it sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government: automotive cybersecurity is a __________ that must be taken seriously.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: real issue=진짜 문제 / minor concern=사소한 걱정 / simple task=간단한 일 / false rumor=거짓 소문
det.analysis:
① minor concern: 사소한 걱정인데 '진지하게'? 모순
② real issue: 진지하게 받아들여야 할 진짜 문제 ←정답
③ simple task: 간단한 일? 진지함과 모순
④ false rumor: 거짓 소문? 진짜 위협과 모순
det.tip: must be taken seriously(진지하게) → real issue(진짜 문제)
